quantity_rules: Each SKU belongs to exactly one slot. At most one SKU per slot. required_units per guest for 5 slots, tablecloth 1. owned_units are accepted 0..99 and effective_owned=min(owned,required). Select ceil((required-effective_owned)/pack_units) packs. No mixed SKU inside slot; alternatives require seller approval. Owned products are buyer-declared, not verified for quality or geometry.
geometry: Rectangular table only. Buyer table length_cm 60..300 and width_cm 40..150 when buying tablecloth. Cloth length/width allows rotation; drop per side 15..30 cm inclusive. Hard checks integer: table_dimension+30 <= cloth_dimension <= table_dimension+60. Skip when tablecloth disabled or fully owned.
preferences: Hard color allowlist by slot optional, exact prelinked SKU if buyer sets EXACT_ONLY. Default seller-approved alternatives allowed. Soft color target optional. Do not infer material/compatibility beyond schema.
objective_order: min number of substituted slots relative to seller confirmed primary SKU
min number of soft color mismatches
min total excess units from pack rounding
min total price including fixed shipping
min tuple of SKU ids in slot_order ASCII; zero purchase represented empty string

fulfillment.zone_selection: explicit enum, no address/phone/payment in demo; unsupported zone rejects delivery, no silent mode switch

determinism: Pure solve request + immutable catalog/template/inventory snapshot + algorithm version -> same canonical solution. IDs/timestamps excluded from equality. ML output not assumed deterministic. Only seller-confirmed mappings can publish. CP-SAT single worker, fixed seed 42, lexicographic phases; every objective must prove optimal before sellable quote. Limit -> COMPUTATION_LIMIT no fake INFEASIBLE. Frozen environment/package lock mandatory.
commerce: quote immutable snapshot, up to15min no stock/pricehold; reserve refresh relevantproduct_version and fulfillment_version, stockavailability only; price/items fixed up to10min, deadline cap. Confirm createsTEST_CONFIRMED. Explicit order cancel returns stock once; consumedreservationremainsCONFIRMED; withdrawal does notcancelorders.
auth: isolated sandbox per visit; opaque random HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie. Sandbox role is demo role, not real authorization; seller/buyer switching allowed inside own sandbox only. All operations scoped server-side. No VK auth required.
modes: CORE deterministic import, manual confirmed mapping, selection, test checkout, verification
ML assisted extraction and candidate retrieval, fails back to manual; required for full showcase but cannot block core
VK native integration outside v1 scope until official permissions verified
notes: Authority: this baseline overrides draft differences. No entrepreneur interviews mandatory. No fabricated commercial lift. No website/app implementation requested yet; deliver spec+contracts+fixtures+acceptance.

deadline.expiry_cap: midnight Europe/Moscow after latest_start_date; quote/reservation expires_at=min(now+ttl,cap); null deadline has no cap

selection_mode: per-slot enum EXACT_ONLY or APPROVED_ALTERNATIVES, default APPROVED_ALTERNATIVES
no_purchase: all selected slots covered by owned_units => NO_PURCHASE_REQUIRED, all totals0, noquote/reserve/order
concurrency: sandbox row mutex first, then SKU rows in ASCII order; solve/ML outside transaction; clock sampled after locks; changes serialized per sandbox
stock_constraint: 0 <= reserved_packs <= stock_on_hand_packs; stock_on_hand_packs+returnable_packs<=10000; returnable=sum active TEST_CONFIRMED order packs

normalization.disabled_slot: all shapevalidation first; then irrelevant prefs/owned normalized todefaults
